checked_scope: The random-game failure probability and expected-time calculation conditional on the manuscript fallback bound.
checks: Zero column of A and zero row of B intersect at a pure equilibrium. Independence across columns, rows, and the two matrices gives exact certificate failure 2(1−q)^n−(1−q)^(2n).
For fixed c≤cρ, the logarithm remainder bounds the fallback base by 1+ρc²/(n−c); its nth power is bounded even at equality c=cρ.

The density sequence (cρ+n^(−1/2))/n instead gives base 1+ρe^(−cρ)n^(−1/2)+O(n^−1), invalidating the naive endpoint-limit extension of this sufficient bound. The imported fallback running-time theorem is expressly conditional.
